the  day 
immediately
preceding  the  relevant  date  shall  be  proceeded
with and concluded as if the said Act has not been
repealed; and
(g)  any  action  or  proceeding  or  thing  commenced
under the repealed Act and pending or remaining
incomplete on the day immediately preceding the
relevant  date  may  be  withdrawn  with  liberty  to
file  a  fresh  action  seeking  the  same  relief  under
any  other  law  for  the  time  being  in  force.  Such
fresh action shall be filed within a period of one
year from the relevant date.
